options.name: Arms of Achaekek
options.benefit: While using mantis mutagen without armor or wrist-slot items, gain two 1d4 secondary claw attacks.

options.name: Blood Sight
options.benefit: While using mantis mutagen, gain darkvision 60 feet and deathwatch; existing racial darkvision increases by 30 feet.

options.name: Improved Arms of Achaekek
options.benefit: Arms of Achaekek claws become 1d6 primary natural weapons when not using manufactured weapons and deal 1d4 bleed.

options.name: Ingest Venom
options.benefit: Once per day, safely store one ingested poison for up to 24 hours and apply it to both Arms of Achaekek claws when the mutagen is used.
